intent: Individually teach wet clothes near a window, loose collar button, blue floral pattern on a white blouse, plain fabric without invented colour, coat advice with strengthening wind, hood-only waterproof scope, wool warmth on a boat and jumper on chair back.

workshop.title: 把衣着细节摆对，再说完整句
workshop.instruction: 改状态、找位置、看修饰范围；每次只改一处，再对照原句。

transfer.stem: 换成毛巾、帽子和书包，哪组三句保留了全部细节？
transfer.passage:
新要求与记录
把湿毛巾（towels）挂在门边。这顶帽子（hat）有一个防水的帽檐（brim）。我把书包（bag）落在椅背上。

options.text: Hang your wet towels near the door. This hat has a waterproof brim. I left my bag on the back of the chair.
Hang your dry towels near the door. This hat has a waterproof brim. I left my bag on the back of the chair.
Hang your wet towels near the door. Every part of this hat is waterproof. I left my bag on the back of the chair.
Hang your wet towels near the door. This hat has a waterproof brim. I left my bag behind the chair on the floor.

answer.display: Hang your wet towels near the door. This hat has a waterproof brim. I left my bag on the back of the chair.

explanation.strategy: 先核对状态与位置，再找准修饰范围，最后核对椅背。

steps.text: 湿毛巾挂在门边：wet towels near the door。
防水的是帽檐：a waterproof brim。
steps.reason: Every part扩大为整顶帽子都防水，原句没有保证。

steps.text: 书包落在椅背上：on the back of the chair。
steps.reason: behind the chair on the floor换成椅子后面的地面。

distractors.reason: Every part扩大了防水的范围。
behind…the floor改变了椅背上的位置。

explanation.pitfall: 看懂名词还不够，wet、修饰范围和on the back都不能漏。
